In the news release, Steel Dynamics Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call and Webcast, issued Oct. 8, 2026 by Steel Dynamics, Inc. over PR Newswire, we are advised by the company that changes have been made. The complete, corrected release follows, with additional details at the end:


### Steel Dynamics Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call and Webcast


FORT WAYNE, Ind.


, Oct. 8, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Steel Dynamics, Inc. (NASDAQ/GS: STLD), a leading industrial metals solutions company in North America, today announced it intends to release third quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Monday, October 19, 2026. The teleconference is scheduled to begin at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, and will be hosted by Mark D. Millett, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer and Theresa E. Wagler, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.


To participate, please dial +1.973.528.0011 at least ten minutes before the start time and reference the Steel Dynamics Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call. The teleconference can also be accessed (in listen-only mode) by visiting the company’s website at[www.steeldynamics.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4793151-1&h=4157268467&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.steeldynamics.com%2F&a=www.steeldynamics.com) . Webcast participants are encouraged to log in prior to 11:00 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time to ensure a connection before the beginning of the call. An audio replay version of the teleconference can be accessed by dialing +1.919.882.2331 and entering conference ID number 54572. The audio replay link will be available on the company’s website until 11:59 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time on October 27, 2026. An MP3 file of the event will be available on the company’s website that can be accessed for online replay or download.


***Correction:** An earlier version of this release incorrectly referenced “Second Quarter” rather than “Third Quarter” in the second paragraph.*
